{{Top|leg}}
A '''marine navicomputer''' was a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] designed to work aboard aquatic vessels. Marine navicomputers contained maps and information about [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] terrain, and assisted [[sailor]]s and crew in navigating the vessel across the water.
